name: liftCochain_v_descCochain_v
statement: ℤ) (h₁₂ : p₁ + n = p₂) (h₂₃ : p₂ + n' = p₃) (q : ℤ) (hq : p₁ + m = q) : (liftCochain φ α β h).v p₁ p₂ h₁₂ ≫ (descCochain φ α' β' h').v p₂ p₃ h₂₃ = α.v p₁ q hq ≫ α'.v q p₃ (by omega) + β.v p₁ p₂ h₁₂ ≫ β'.v p₂ p₃ h₂₃
